create_8bit_linear_layer: create a Linear8bitLt layer from a weight tensor and bias for 8-bit quantized inference
create_fp4_linear_layer: create a Linear4bit layer with fp4 quantization from a weight tensor and bias
create_nf4_linear_layer: create a Linear4bit layer with nf4 quantization from a weight tensor and bias
build_bnb_weight_wrapper: build a BNBWeight dataclass to wrap a torch tensor and produce a Linear8bitLt layer via get_linear
run_8bit_matmul_forward: run the forward pass of a Linear8bitLt layer on an input tensor using bnb.matmul
